source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The entry 2111 author reports that --verify exposed deletion selection updates arriving after a test manually changed the selected index. The patch pre-arms a select-event promise before each key expected to change selection and awaits that event instead of one event-loop tick. Its direct selectedIndex assignment uses a predicate for the expected target. The accepted TreeView can emit select after a configured delay, so a tick alone is not its completion contract. The test keeps timed gaps and scrollend stabilization for its deliberate smooth-scroll scenario; this is not evidence that all arbitrary delays were removed. Current key descriptors are KEY_PageUp, KEY_PageDown and KEY_Delete. The task checks scroll direction and visible selection boundaries. No --verify, repeated deletion, browser or live accessibility run occurred; the source/test inspection does not prove the product’s concurrent-user-interaction race was fixed. Full discussion is pending.
title: Await the thread selection event before the next deletion-test action
